# 🔌 MCP Servers Directory

![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.1.0-blue) ![servers](https://img.shields.io/badge/servers-81-green) ![official](https://img.shields.io/badge/official-71-brightgreen) ![categories](https://img.shields.io/badge/categories-16-purple) [![CI](https://github.com/Amarel-Taylor-Scott/mcp-servers-directory/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Amarel-Taylor-Scott/mcp-servers-directory/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

> A curated, machine-readable directory of **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** servers — the small programs that expose tools, resources, and prompts to MCP clients like Claude Desktop, IDEs, and agents.

MCP is an open standard for connecting LLM apps to external systems. This repo catalogs public servers with links and install commands, and ships a small CLI to search/filter/export the registry. Entries link to their upstream projects — no third-party code is vendored here.

## Quick start

```bash
pip install -e .            # or: pip install -r requirements.txt
mcp-dir list                # list all servers
mcp-dir search postgres     # search the server catalog
mcp-dir search retrieval --scope all --limit 5 --format json
mcp-dir list --category search_engines
mcp-dir packs video --format json  # find seed packs, with pinned guides and manifests
mcp-dir categories          # show categories + counts
mcp-dir export --format json > servers.json
mcp-dir generate            # regenerate this README
```

## At a glance

- **81** servers across **16** categories
- **71** official / first-party servers (✅)
- 🔑 = requires an API key / auth · transports: `stdio`, `sse`, `http`

## Related resources

[Search and retrieval guide](resources/search-and-retrieval.md) compares index search, web retrieval, vector search and reranking, with an offline full-text example.

[ta-amps projects and seed packs](resources/ta-amps.md) connects Teleion Fabric, Herma and Eranos to reusable task templates. [Browse the full seed pack index](resources/ta-amps-seedpacks.csv).

For portable skill formats, agent extensions and marketplaces, see the [AI Agent Skills & Extensions Directory](https://github.com/Amarel-Taylor-Scott/ai-agent-skills-directory).

## What is MCP?

The Model Context Protocol standardizes how applications provide context to LLMs. A **client** (e.g. Claude Desktop) connects to one or more **servers**, each of which exposes *tools* (actions), *resources* (data), and *prompts*. Learn more at <https://modelcontextprotocol.io>.

## Contributing

Add or correct an entry in [`data.py`](data.py), run `python main.py generate`, and open a PR. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Listings are pointers to public projects; if you maintain a server and want it changed or removed, open an issue.
